note: Macro compile time: #[route] no longer parses handler bodies into a syn::Block (only attributes, visibility and signature; the body is delimited and re-emitted verbatim), roughly halving its parse cost per handler. The vespera!/export_app! route cache key now fingerprints the macro's own sources located via its compile-time CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR plus the sibling vespera_core sources, so edits to vespera_core and git / out-of-repo path dependencies of vespera invalidate target/vespera/*.cache instead of serving a stale spec; packaged crates.io builds still cost one stat. Generated output is unchanged.
